label: linux-amd64-2vcpu-512mib-synthetic
scope: Synthetic deterministic corpus; measures this build on this host, not editorial quality.
target: 100000 prose words within 10 seconds and 512 MiB
host: Intel Xeon E-2276G at 3.80GHz, Debian 12, shared 8-CPU Docker host
cpu_limit: 2 CPUs of quota (--cpus 2); the container still reports 8 logical CPUs, so GOMAXPROCS was set explicitly
memory_limit: 512 MiB cgroup with no swap; the kernel kills a scan that exceeds it
